parameters.content:
## i1 · Market Screener
Up to 10 keywords → one Amazon search each → shared Toolkit Core → markets ranked by opportunity score, with variants merged and the differences between them shown. No AI. Free stack: self-hosted n8n, SerpApi free tier, Google Sheets. Failures email an alert (e0).

## History
Reads the shared Listings tab once, so each keyword is compared with its previous run (stability). Empty tab is fine.

## Evidence first
Listings are saved before keyword and market rows, so no summary exists without the listings behind it.

parameters.formDescription: Paste up to 10 keywords, one per line. Keywords that are really the same market (e.g. "resistance band" and "resistance bands") are merged and the differences between them are shown. Results go to the Markets and Keywords tabs.
